paper.title: Anytime Model Selection in Linear Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Online model selection for linearly parametrizable bandits
unmapped: Model selection among M candidate feature maps phi_j: R^{d0} -> R^d, one of which realizes the reward (group sparsity: one nonzero group of size d in R^{Md})
Reward is linear in an unknown (but one-of-M) nonlinear feature map of the action, domain X subset R^{d0} compact
Image of each phi_j spans R^d and no two feature maps are linearly dependent; concatenated map normalized ||phi(x)|| <= 1
Learner needs the number of models M and the exploration quantity C_min (max over designs of min eigenvalue of covariance)
settings.definition_quote: At step $t$ the learner selects an action $\vx_t \in \calX$, where $\calX \subset \sR^{d_0}$ is a compact domain and observes a noisy reward $y_t = r(\vx_t) + \varepsilon_t$ such that $\varepsilon_t$ is an i.i.d.~zero-mean sub-Gaussian variable with parameter $\sigma^2$. ... there exists $j^\star \in [M]$ such that $r(\cdot) = \vtheta^\top_{j^\star} \vphi_{j^\star}(\cdot)$. ... $\norm{\vphi(\vx)} \leq 1$ ... $\norm{\vtheta_{j^\star}}\leq B$

algorithms.name: ALEXP (Anytime Exponential weighting based on Lasso reward estimates)

symbols.C_min: max over exploration distributions pi of lambda_min(E_pi phi(x)phi(x)^T)
symbols.C_conf: C(M,delta,d) = sqrt(1 + log(M/delta) + (loglog d)_+ + sqrt(d(log(M/delta) + (loglog d)_+)))

conditions: oracle agent j* uses UCB or Greedy policy; other agents arbitrary

source.label: thm:regret_main
source.quote: Then \alexp satisfies the cumulative regret R(n) = O(n^{3/4}B + n^{3/4}C(M,\delta,d) + \cmin^{-1}\sqrt{n} C(M,\delta,d)\log M + \cmin^{-1/2}n^{5/8}\sqrt{d\log(n) + \log(1/\delta)}) simultaneously for all $n \geq 1$, with probability greater than $1-\delta$.

results.notes: Informal theorem; holds simultaneously for all n w.p. 1-delta, horizon not needed. Paper summarizes as O(max{sqrt(n log^3 M), n^{3/4} sqrt(log M)}).

bound.expression: S*T**(3/4) + sqrt(T)*C_conf*log(M)/C_min + S**2*C_min*sqrt(T) + S*sqrt(T*(log(log(T*S**2)) + log(1/delta))) + (1 + T**(-3/8)*sqrt(log(M*d/delta) + log(log(T)))/C_min)*(S*T**(1/4) + (T**(3/4) + log(T)/C_min)*C_conf + T**(5/8)*sqrt(d*log(T) + log(1/delta) + S**2)/sqrt(C_min))
bound.expression_latex: C_1Bn^{3/4} + C_2 \sqrt{n} \cmin^{-1} C(M, \delta, d)\log M +C_3 B^2\cmin\sqrt{n} + C_4 B\sqrt{ n\left( (\log \log nB^2)_+ + \log(1/\delta)\right)} + C_5 (1+\cmin^{-1}n^{-3/8}\sqrt{\log(Md/\delta) + (\log\log n)_+} ) \times [ Bn^{1/4} + (n^{3/4} + \frac{\log n}{\cmin})C(M, \delta, d)+ \frac{n^{5/8}}{\sqrt{\cmin}}\sqrt{d\log n + \log(1/\delta) + B^2}]

symbols.C_min: max over exploration distributions of min eigenvalue of feature covariance
symbols.C_conf: C(M,delta,d) = C_6 sigma sqrt(1 + sqrt(d(log(M/delta)+(loglog d)_+)) + log(M/delta) + (loglog d)_+)

conditions: oracle agent uses UCB or Greedy policy

source.label: thm:main_regret_rigorous
source.quote: Let $\delta \in (0, 1]$ and $\pi$ be the maximizer of \eqref{eq:cmin_def}. Assume the oracle agent employs a UCB or a Greedy policy... then exists absolute constants $C_1, \dots, C_6$ for which \algo attains the regret R(n) \leq C_1Bn^{3/4} + C_2 \sqrt{n} \cmin^{-1} C(M, \delta, d)\log M + ... with probability greater than $1-\delta$, simultaneously for all $n \geq 1$.

results.notes: Unspecified absolute constants C_1..C_6, recorded with O notation. loglog terms are positive parts in the paper.

bound.expression: S*T**(3/4) + sqrt(T)*C_conf*log(M) + S**2*sqrt(T) + S*sqrt(T*(log(log(T*S**2)) + log(1/delta))) + (T**(3/4) + log(T))*C_conf + T**(5/8)*sqrt(d*log(T) + log(1/delta) + S**2)
bound.expression_latex: Bn^{3/4} + \sqrt{n} C(M, \delta, d)\log M + B^2 \sqrt{n} + B\sqrt{ n\left( (\log \log nB^2)_+ + \log(1/\delta)\right)} +(n^{3/4} + \log n )C(M, \delta, d)+ n^{5/8}\sqrt{d\log n + \log(1/\delta) + B^2}

symbols.C_conf: C(M,delta,d) = sqrt(1 + sqrt(d(log(M/delta)+(loglog d)_+)) + log(M/delta) + (loglog d)_+)

conditions: feature maps phi_j: X -> R chosen from an orthogonal basis of L^2(X) with ||phi_i||_{L^2}/Vol(X) >= 1
oracle agent uses UCB or Greedy policy

source.label: cor:alexp_unif
source.quote: Suppose $\vphi_j: \calX \rightarrow \sR$ are chosen from an orthogonal basis of $L^2(\calX)$ ... then \algo with uniform exploration $\pi = \mathrm{Unif}(\calX)$ attains the regret R(n) = O( Bn^{3/4} + \sqrt{n} C(M, \delta, d)\log M + B^2 \sqrt{n} + ... ) with probability greater than $1-\delta$, simultaneously for all $n \geq 1$.

results.notes: C_min-free bound under orthonormal scalar features; learner does not need C_min here.
